_meta.what: What the account progresses first: the weight the arbiter multiplies an activity's value by (docs/design/AI_PLAYER_OVERHAUL.md section 4.4). The director changes a weight from the console (live/control.json goal_weights); this file is the default.
_meta.source: RUL-2026-11-11-149 item 5: PvP wins first, then the daily caps (50 errands, 20 missions, 9 medical), then ryo and hunting materials, with training always kept running as upkeep.
_meta.note: The order is the director's. The numbers only encode that order; Fable chose them. Training, restock and repair are upkeep: they run on their own priority class and are not weighted here.
